security_audit.summary: Of 59 static findings, 58 concern Markdown syntax, documented service links, expected credential configuration, or readable Chinese text rather than threats. The CLI example automatically executes an unpinned npm package, creating a supply-chain risk with access to the configured API credential. No evidence found of prompt injection, embedded secrets, or intentional credential exfiltration in the supplied files; external package behavior was not inspected.

remediation.issue: The CLI example executes socialdatax-skills@latest with automatic npm installation and access to the configured API key.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version in the command and installation metadata; require approval before installation and use a restricted environment for execution.

content.user_title: Research Douyin Competitors and Content Angles
content.value_statement: Douyin competitor research needs relevant samples and traceable evidence. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and organizes returned content for focused comparisons.
actual_capabilities: Guide Douyin keyword or topic searches through the SocialDataX CLI or the corresponding MCP search tool.
Apply documented sorting, publication-time, duration, and video or image content filters.
Bound CLI searches by page count or item count and continue with returned pagination tokens.
Organize returned titles, authors, content IDs, links, and available metrics separately from analytical judgments.
Distinguish image results and audio resources from video content using returned media metadata.
Preserve partial results and resume searches after errors while respecting the original collection limits.
limitations: Requires an external SocialDataX service, a configured API key, and sufficient account balance.
The direct CLI requires Node.js, npm, network access, and permission to execute an external package.
Keyword search is not exhaustive and does not support collecting all possible results.
The documented workflow is read-only and does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Compare Brand Content Angles
use_cases.description: Collect samples for competing brands using consistent filters and compare observed topics with traceable references.

use_cases.title: Review a Creator Category
use_cases.description: Sample recent content in a creator category and organize findings for an agency planning review.

use_cases.title: Explore a New Topic
use_cases.description: Find relevant titles and formats around a proposed topic, then identify narrower questions for further research.

prompt_templates.title: Find an Initial Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Douyin for [topic] and collect one page. List returned titles, authors, and links or IDs without inventing missing fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect a small keyword sample.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Recent Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [keyword] among videos published within the last week. Sort newest first and collect at most 20 items.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: define a focused collection scope.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Competitor Angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [brand A] and [brand B] using identical filters, with 20 items per brand. Separate observed content angles from interpretations and retain references.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare evidence across two competitor searches.

prompt_templates.title: Resume a Bounded Research Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume the partial [keyword] search using its saved continuation token and unchanged filters. Deduct collected totals from the original limits and report remaining gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover an interrupted multi-page collection.

output_examples.input: Show the report format for a one-page search about home fitness.
output: Illustrative format only; no live search was performed.
Scope: home fitness keyword, one page, default filters.
Sample record: returned title, author, link or content ID, and content type.
Analysis: observed angle, supporting reference, and next research question.
Coverage: a keyword sample, not a complete category inventory.

output_examples.input: Show how a partial competitor search would be summarized.
output: Illustrative recovery summary; no live API result is represented.
Status: incomplete; retain collected samples and the reported error.
Continuation: resume with the saved token and original keyword and filters after resolving the error.
Limits: reduce remaining pages and items by totals already collected.
Caution: do not restart automatically from page one when no continuation token is available.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on collection limits before expanding a paid search.
Use consistent filters across competitors and retain references while separating evidence from interpretation.
Approve external package execution, use a reviewed pinned version, and keep API keys out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating a keyword sample or an empty page as proof of complete market coverage.
Changing query filters while reusing a pagination token from another search chain.
Repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors or automatically repeating already collected pages.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill support?
faq.answer: Start with a keyword or topic. Add supported time, duration, sorting, or content-type filters to narrow the search.

faq.question: What do I need before running a search?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and sufficient provider balance. The CLI also requires Node.js, npm, network access, and execution permission.

faq.question: Does this skill publish or modify Douyin accounts?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, posting, liking, commenting, and account changes.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching result?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete-result boundary. Use page or item limits and describe findings as sampled evidence.

faq.question: How should interrupted searches be resumed?
faq.answer: Keep partial results and use the returned continuation token with unchanged filters. Subtract collected totals from the original limits.

faq.question: What should happen when the account balance is insufficient?
faq.answer: Stop repeated retries and use the provider billing page. After resolving the balance issue, resume under the documented continuation rules.
